summary: What S17 raises and S16 builds stands on the board: two read-only state-dictionary keys, building_instances and machine_instances, and the placement code that stands P12's kits on the holding cell at the world and route distances and inside the room's footprint at the socket the record names.

coordination.notes: Lane S19 edits the journal match arms in godot_bridge.rs this round; this lane's hunks are confined to expedition_state_dictionary (two `result.set` blocks, each beside the registry array it belongs with) and two helper functions placed immediately before world_event_dictionary, so the two merge as keep-both. No ExpeditionState field was added, so EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS is untouched. game/scripts/blockouts/ is called through `build` and not edited; no content, tools/, strategy/, battle/, shell/ or ui/ file is touched. native_expedition_port.gd needed NO change: `snapshot()` forwards the bridge dictionary verbatim, so the two new keys cross on the line that was already there, and mock_simulation_port.gd carries no expedition snapshot at all (it is the battle-side fixture), so there is no mock shape to keep in agreement. game/tests/board_verification_campaign.gd is P4's and P10's shared owner of the campaign both board proofs run; it gained the developed island rather than this lane declaring a second one, which is the no-fork rule applied to a fixture. capture_board_distances.gd gained two states at the END of its sequence and P10's five are untouched in order or content.

The card's live-bridge campaign is NOT reachable and the suite says so at length instead of faking it. Measured, not assumed: a campaign begun through CampaignSession, four cells handed out through set_control, 60 in-world days (1,440 strategic hours) driven through resolve_midnight -- current_goals is empty for all six factions at every step, because S5 scores a goal out of stockpiles and relationships and a bridge campaign seeds neither (the determinism harness's a_campaign() seeds both, which is why the harness reaches S17's Develop branch). And nothing finishes a building: S17's own shipped paragraph records that advance_construction has no caller on a clock, and produce_machine refuses a building that is not Operational, so a machine is unreachable through the tick at any budget. The island is therefore developed through the bridge's own save round trip, the way P4 drove its force before S18 landed, and BoardVerificationCampaign.develop_island carries the note that a verb replaces it: failed
